title: The Veranda
motto: Where we sit, talk and watch the street.
description: Essays on Ghana's built environment: climate, design, materials and the way we build. Written by Joseph Eguei Yartey.
author: Joseph Eguei Yartey
about_short: In Ghana, the veranda is where people sit, talk and watch the street go by. This journal is a place to do the same with the buildings, streets and cities around us.

upcoming.title: Laterite, earth and the materials we overlook
Accra floods every year. Our sites are part of it.
